aboutGame.title: What is Potato Please?
paragraphs: Potato Please is a cozy potato-peeling and idle farming game built around a simple four-beat loop: gather raw spuds, prepare them into dishes, serve waiting customers, and reinvest the earnings into tools, stations, and capacity. It is easy to pick up, but the decision layer of when to bank, when to spend, and which upgrade to buy is what separates fast progress from a stalled farm.

Beyond the opening hours, Potato Please opens up passive income, automation, level goals with star ratings, and a deep upgrade tree. Our wiki covers every system with practical guides, upgrade priority tables, achievement routes, and release details so new and returning players always know their next step.

modules.description: Covers the basic gameplay loop, first steps, and the core objective so new players can start confidently.

highlights.detail: Finish the tutorial without skipping so you know which button produces value and which one only spends it.
Identify your currencies and separate fast renewable income from rare, slow resources.
Make one cheap upgrade immediately to confirm you understand the spend loop before costs rise.
Watch the timers for one full cycle to learn the rhythm the game expects you to play at.
Bank rare resources until you understand their real value instead of spending them early.
Keep all four loop beats running at once instead of obsessing over a single mechanic.

faq.title: Potato Please FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Potato Please.

items.question: What is Potato Please?
items.answer: Potato Please is a cozy potato-peeling and idle farming game built around a four-beat loop: gather spuds, prepare dishes, serve customers, and upgrade your tools. It blends relaxing hands-on play with progression, automation, and level goals.

items.question: How do I start Potato Please as a beginner?
items.answer: Finish the tutorial without skipping, identify your currencies, and make one cheap upgrade immediately. Our Potato Please beginner guide walks through the first hours, the core loop, and the mistakes that stall new players.

items.question: Which Potato Please upgrades should I buy first?
items.answer: Prioritize output upgrades that raise income per action, then add passive generation so you keep earning while away. Speed, capacity, multipliers, and automation come next once your base output is established.

items.question: How do Potato Please levels and star ratings work?
items.answer: Each Potato Please level pairs a primary goal with a move or time limit, and star thresholds reward efficiency rather than simple completion. Read the goal and constraint before your first move.

items.question: Where can I find the Potato Please release date?
items.answer: The exact launch day is not publicly fixed yet. Wishlist Potato Please on the official Steam store page to get an alert, and check our release information page for platform and price updates.
